title: 打电话给美国餐厅点外卖，英语怎么说？
summary: 不想用 App，打电话点外卖更快。这篇教你电话点餐的开场白、报菜名、问取餐时间的完整说法。

featuredPhrase.en: I'd like to place a takeout order.

phrases.en: I'd like to place a takeout order.
Can I get this to go?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like to place a takeout order.

dialogue.speaker: Restaurant
dialogue.en: Sure! What can I get for you?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: One kung pao chicken and two egg rolls. How long will it take?
dialogue.zh: 一份宫保鸡丁，两份蛋卷。要多久能好？

dialogue.speaker: Restaurant
dialogue.en: About 20 minutes. Name and phone number?
dialogue.zh: 大概 20 分钟。留个名字和电话？

dialogue.speaker: Restaurant
dialogue.en: Sorry, pickup only. See you in 20 minutes!
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，只自取。20 分钟后见！
